data.title: Colorful Patterns
data.description: Learn to recognize and extend AB and AAB color patterns with fun and colorful blocks!

challenges.instruction: Look at the red and blue pattern. What comes next?
challenges.hint: Say the colors out loud: red, blue, red, blue. What color comes after blue?
challenges.narration: Let's look at this red and blue pattern. Can you help me finish it?

challenges.instruction: Can you extend this green and yellow pattern?
challenges.hint: Listen to the beat: green, yellow, green, yellow. What is next?
challenges.narration: Great job! Now let's try a green and yellow pattern.

challenges.instruction: This pattern goes red, red, blue! Can you extend it?
challenges.hint: Remember the rule: two reds, then one blue. What comes after blue?
challenges.narration: Ooh, this one is an AAB pattern! Two reds and a blue. Let's finish it together.

challenges.instruction: Here is an AAB pattern with green and yellow. What comes next?
challenges.hint: Check the core: green, green, yellow. What starts the next part?
challenges.narration: You are doing wonderful! Let's do another two-green, one-yellow pattern.

challenges.instruction: This pattern has three colors: red, yellow, and blue. Can you extend it?
challenges.hint: Follow the ABC order: red, then yellow, then blue. Keep going!
challenges.narration: Now we have a three-color ABC pattern! Red, yellow, blue. What comes next?

challenges.instruction: This is a tricky AAB pattern with blue and orange. Finish the pattern!
challenges.hint: Count the blues: one, two. Then one orange. What follows orange?
challenges.narration: This is our final challenge! You've got this, superstar!
